This Appeal, Coming On For Further Orders, This
Day, The Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment

This appeal under Section 54(2) of the Land Acquisition Act (for short 'the Act') is filed challenging the judgment and award dated 07.04.2007 passed by the Principal Civil Judge, Hassan in LAC No.231/2006 and the judgment and award dated 07.11.2014 passed by the Principal District Judge,
Hassan in R.A.No.322/2014 by which the market value of the Site No.252, measuring 33 ft. x 66 ft.
situated at Handinaker village, Kasaba Hobli, Hassan Taluk and District was fixed at Rs.24/- per Sq.ft.
2.
Heard the learned counsel for the appellant and learned HCGP for the respondent-State.

3. The subject site was proposed to be acquired by issuing preliminary notification dated 25.09.1997 under Section 4(1) of the Act, for the purpose of Yagachi Reservoir Project, which culminated in passing of the award dated 24.01.2000 by the Land Acquisition Officer, fixing the market value of the subject site at Rs.9.50/- per Sq.ft.
4.
The Reference Court enhanced the market value at Rs.16/- per Sq.ft.

The First Appellate Court further enhanced the market value at Rs. 24/- per Sq.ft.,
5.

The Division Bench of this Court in MFA No.8760/2018 has fixed the market value of the land acquired therein for the very same purpose under the notification dated 11.02.2009 at Rs.1,00,000/- per gunta.

The Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of "Union of India (UOI) Vs. Bal Ram and Anr.," reported in (AIR 2004) SC 3981 has held that it would be unfair to discriminate between the land owners to pay more to some and less to others when the purpose of acquisition is same and lands are identical and similar, though lying in different villages.

2 Rs.1,00,000/- per gunta so as to maintain parity.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) Appeal is allowed in part.
(ii) Market of the value of subject land is fixed at Rs.1,00,000/- per gunta with all admissible statutory benefits including cost.
( iii) It is made clear that appellants/claimants are not entitled for the interest for the delayed period of 2145 days in filing the appeal.
I.A.No.1/2022 does not survive for consideration in view of the disposal of the main appeal.
